items.title: Report regime-matched corrected ice signal from the annual-mean zero-forcing pair (23873250/251), on the beam-blocked 30/43 subset: min + time-weighted mean + range
Explain the -3.9 K whole-cycle mean offset on the polygon floor; rigid-shift and faster-tracking both ruled out
items.note: RESOLVED: not a physical offset. The ice-dry differential is unconverged after 2 yr; matched-season drift -1.22 K/yr = 104% of the -1.17 K signal.

items.title: Shadowed-floor Diviner extraction for CTRL2/CTRL3 (~18 full 240 m px each) to close the sunlit-vs-shadowed regime gap in the bias envelope
Push the local-only HANDOFF commits to origin, or add a GitHub credential so CS can push
items.note: WRONG AS FILED. CC pushes routinely (osxkeychain on the host); every earlier CS commit reached origin on CC's next push. No credential is needed from the PI.

items.title: At the end of each session run 'git push origin feature/terrain-viewfactors' even if you made no commits, so a trailing CS commit does not wait for your next one
items.note: CC adopted the contract and pushed; branch in sync, 0 ahead. Verified: git status shows no divergence.

items.title: Do NOT close A1 with a corrected signal: the zero-forcing control cannot remove differential spin-up. Extend the seasonal pair until matched-season drift < 0.1 K, and save the per-lunation differential as a convergence diagnostic
items.note: measured: differential starts +0.06 K, reaches -6.3 K, drifts -1.22 K/yr matched-season
